| doc | The ONE movement and feel tuning file (owner 11-08), read by scripts/core/locomotion.gd (Loco) for the farm avatar and every match hunter alike. Live: with the movement readout open (F7, or Settings > Controls), saving this file re-reads it within poll_s. Units: m, s, m/s, m/s^2; drags are 1/s (the share of the excess lost per second, exponential). air: accel = how hard WASD pushes in the air; counter = multiplier on accel for the part of your speed going against the keys (a backward drift turns forward in ~0.1 s); side = multiplier for the part going across the keys (bends the arc); drag = how fast speed above your run cap (dash, knock, launch) bleeds in the air; idle_drag = the share of its speed a jump with no keys loses per second ([game data] the reference's falling friction x its braking factor, 0.375 x 2). glide (the pull toward where you steer is [game data], HunterMove.glide_accel): turn / turn_fast = deg/s at cruise and the share kept at the max; brake / brake_deg = pulling back past this angle brakes this hard; drag = how fast speed above cruise bleeds with no keys, drag_steer = the same while steering (owner playtest 11-13 'like the reference': a dash-glide still has >= 10.5 m/s 1 s in, back near cruise in ~3-4 s); coast = m/s^2 a let-go under cruise slows; catch = m/s^2 the canopy eases a fall to its sink rate (absorbed, never turned into speed; ours: the source clamps the fall the step the glider opens, HunterMove.glide_start_vy, and its fastest-fall half is locked); max = the fastest a glide carries; swoop / swoop_fade [game data] GlideDownwardForceSwoopSpeedTransferRatio / SwoopSpeedFadeTime: on a level-out, the fall the glider's own pull or dive built (never a fall you opened it in) becomes swoop x that much forward speed (half while overheated), gone swoop_fade s later (GlideLift). glide_carry: per hunter, speed above this carried from Shift into a glide bleeds at carry_drag (on top of drag), so a dash never turns into a long sprint. dash.jump_keep: the share of a ground dash's speed a jump out of it keeps (the rest is air drag's, Loco.air_step; 1 = all of it, a long dash-jump). dash_glide (scripts/match/dash_glide.gd, owner 11-11 'a weird hitch when i shift->glider'): ease_t = s, the time constant a kit's cut of an air dash's speed eases out over instead of one step; grace = s after an air dash a fresh glide press still counts as a press in the dash and opens the glider at once, past the kit's wind-down (per hunter, under WINDOW 0.3; juggernaut 0.25: owner playtest 11-13, Brall's dash + glide must not wait out his 0.35 s wind-down; the source's patch 05.02.25 had none right after his dash). press_buffer: s a press made too early still goes when it becomes allowed, the one window players feel for all three: past a dash's end while the hunter can't act (DashFlow), before a two-step's recast arms (ArchKit), before a crowd control ends (DashFlow, docs/decisions/0022); a cast-lock press buffer reads it too, and a kit that needs another window keeps a per-kit override with its source; source: owner 11-08 'recasts buffered ~0.15 s' (DECISIONS two-step abilities), the footage gives no field (decision 0026). dash_speed: per hunter, a dash's speed scale (its time stretches so the distance stays); the shape of a dash (ease in, peak, skid) is the hunter's source curve in content/rules/dash_feel.json. sources: notes only (never read as numbers): where each glide/air value comes from, settled or Not determinable with the frames (sv/FEEL.md). |

## tutorial (`content/rules/tutorial.json`)

|---|---|
| doc | The first-match tutorial (scripts/match/tutorial.gd, TutorialCamps). The hunter lands at level 1 with one ability point and every ability locked, the same as a real run; each pick_<slot> step lets only that slot take a point (its key, the glowing slot or Alt + key) and waits for it, and each camp's kills pay the XP for the next level (camps: the step that spawns it, its monsters, the level its last kill reaches, 0 for none; row = in a line in front of you; hp = its own share of the monster's health in place of camp_hp). steps: [id, the one banner line]. quiet: the steps that are only a one-line first-time hint (TutorialHints: no strip, check or sting, an ability pick is made for you), the rest are the banner steps; hint: the quiet line for a step, else its own line. detail: a plain-words second line under it (%L the step's ability in the kit's own words, %X the E ability in words, %R the rank-up keys, %N the E ability's name, %U the ultimate's level, %F interact). %K the step's own key (its cap), %Y the Ultimate's key (R) and %Z its name (the Fusion is the ultimate key, X), %J jump, %G glide, %E the E key, %T the Boki key, %s the Boki's name, %A the step's ability name; the step's key shows as a key cap beside the line. alt: the line for a variant of a step. labels: the marker's caption per step. mob: how the tutorial's monsters differ from real ones (camp_hp times the health, so the kills come quickly; size up, damage and attack tempo down). cds: the share of its usual time every ability, dash and glove cooldown takes here. need: how many times a step's action must land, shown as 1/3 on the pill. 'wayout' is the Ways Out hook: the one step the limited-ways-out work swaps for its own exit beat. retry: the one line shown when you fall into the abyss and the beat starts again (same tokens; default for the steps without one). |

## unstable_mix (`content/rules/unstable_mix.json`)

When two Boki are paired in the Nesting Nook the pair is an unstable mix if their elements clash (a pair in clashes) or their tempers oppose (bravery or temper at least trait_gap apart, 0 to 1). The baby then hatches with joy at hatch_joy (0 to 100) and the 'Needs extra care' tag, which clears after care_s seconds spent doing at least fine_condition (0 to 100 Care.condition). A story, never a loss. types maps each game type id to its standard name (GAME_RULES_NOV8, 18 types).

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| hatch_joy | 35 |
| care_s | 86400 |
| fine_condition | 50 |
| trait_gap | 0.5 |
| traits | {"temper": ["hot-headed", "mellow"], "bravery": ["bold", "timid"]} |
| types | {"ember": "Fire", "tide": "Water", "bloom": "Grass", "storm": "Electric", "frost": "Ice", "venom": "Poison", "swarm": "Bug", "stone": "Rock", "tempest": "Flying", "wild": "Normal", "titan": "Steel", "wyrm": "Dragon", "shadow": "Dark", "lunar": "Fairy", "prism": "Crystal", "spore": "Spore", "echo": "Sound", "gravity": "Psychic"} |
| clashes | [["ember", "frost"], ["ember", "tide"], ["ember", "bloom"], ["tide", "storm"], ["storm", "stone"], ["bloom", "venom"], ["shadow", "lunar"], ["shadow", "gravity"], ["frost", "wyrm"], ["wyrm", "lunar"]] |

## wade (`content/rules/wade.json`)

Boki wading (GARDEN.md section 4, scripts/home/boki_wade.gd; only while farm_build.json base_mode is on). A Boki in pond or stream water walks at wade_speed (shallow edge) or deep_speed (the middle) of its dry speed, splashes going in, leaves a ripple ring round it (a wave every ripple_secs) and a V wake while it moves (scripts/home/boki_wake.gd), and shakes off coming out. Water, Ice and Crystal leans swim: with linger_chance a free roaming one stays linger_secs in the water playing (the splash clip) and gains joy_per_sec. Fire leans hurry out: at out_speed to the nearest dry ground, which takes under 2 s. Everyone else wades through. Water deeper than half a rigged Boki's height floats it (BokiRig): a swim type swims level, the rest paddle head up. Units: multipliers of walk speed, seconds, joy points a second.

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| wade_speed | 0.6 |
| deep_speed | 0.45 |
| ripple_secs | 0.6 |
| shake_secs | 0.6 |
| swim | ["water", "ice", "prism", "frost", "crystal"] |
| swim_doc | Lean or species-theme keys (HomeToys.lean_of) that linger in the water, and species themes whose rigged Boki swim level in deep water (BokiRig.swimmer): the Water, Ice and Crystal types (themes prism and frost today). |
| swim_depth | 1 |
| swim_depth_doc | m of water over the bed in a pond's deep middle under a rigged Boki, more than half of a farm Boki's height, so BokiRig floats it and it swims or paddles instead of walking on the bed. A Boki without a rig has no swim clips and stands BokiWade.SINK in, as before. |
| fire | ["fire", "ember"] |
| fire_doc | Lean or species-theme keys that step out fast: the Fire type (theme ember today). |
| out_speed | 1.5 |
| out_reach | 8 |
| out_reach_doc | m: how far a Fire Boki looks for dry ground to step out to. |
| linger_chance | 0.6 |
| linger_secs | [4.0, 8.0] |
| joy_per_sec | 0.8 |

## wall_kick (`content/rules/wall_kick.json`)



| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| doc | Diminishing returns for chained wall kicks (WallMoves, decision 0158, owner 11-13: a reduced move per jump). curve: the share of a kick's rise and push-off a kick keeps, by its place in the chain (kick 1, kick 2, then the last entry for every later kick). The chain is the kicks since your feet last touched the ground; landing resets it. HOP_CLIMB_CAP still stops a hop that starts too high. |

## warden_look (`content/rules/warden_look.json`)



| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| doc | A Warden 3D model's own shading over the shared painted look (WardenGlb.look), keyed by the model's art name (art/wardens/<art>/<art>.glb; a design variant has its own key). painted: hero_toon.gdshader parameters on all of its surfaces, set after WardenGlb.PAINTED. slots: the same per toon slot (skin, hair, cloth, leather, metal, eyes, glow), after painted. Colours are [r, g, b]. A model without an entry keeps the shared look. Useful keys: rim_far and rim_far_color (a rim in the Hunter's signature colour at the match camera), top_light (surfaces facing up lift), fres and fres_tint (the coloured rim; 1 = lightened own colour), far_lift (brighter and richer at the match camera), shade and shadow_tint (the shadow floor and its tint), sheen, glow (emission x the painted colour), light_neutral_warm (how much of the hue it takes out of warm lights; WardenGlb.PAINTED 0.8 so the amber sun leaves no red cast, 1 for none at all). halos: glow discs of a constant size on screen on the model's anchors (a lens a pixel wide at the match camera): anchor, color, strength, px (radius on screen), near and far (m: none this close, full from there; close-ups keep the lens itself). albedo: a colour multiplier on the slot's atlas, applied on top of the player's colour pick (it never replaces the pick). Match zoom (the shared far_* look, WardenGlb.PAINTED; set these per model only to tune it): far_fres (the pale fresnel's share left at the match camera, 0.35), far_spec (gloss, sheen and the lights' rims there, 0), far_clamp (stray texels pulled to their coarser mip, 0.8), far_rim_soft (1: rim_far is a broad saturated band in rim_far_color; keep rim_far 0.25-0.35), far_glow (whatever glows a step brighter there, 0.6). no_ink: material tags or slots drawn without the ink shell (e.g. ["gum", "crossbow"]). ink: the model's own ink shell, far_thin (0.8), far_cut (0.55: gone from ~13.5 m; 0 keeps it), color. glow_shell: the glow slot's halo at the match camera (glow_px 1.4 screen px, glow_k 1.3, glow_near 7, glow_far 14 m, glow_col; {"glow_px": 0} for none). A card slot's far keys (shaders/warden_card.gdshader, under slots.card): far_sheen 0, far_edge 1, far_alpha 1.35. the same per toon slot (skin, hair, cloth, leather, metal, brass, eyes, glow), after painted; a "<slot>-<tag>" key (hair-braid: the woven braids) after its slot. char_k, char_reach and char_col: the skin round the emission layer's cracks (its mip char_reach) turns to char_col by char_k, so only the cracks glow (Kael's char). paint_glow, paint_glow_color and paint_glow_width: texels of that painted colour glow (a skin's tattoos at night). weapon_scale: a size multiplier on the held .glb weapon; weapon_offset: [x, y, z] metres that move it in the Gun's space (seats the grip in the hand: Lace's bow). |

## warden_native (`content/rules/warden_native.json`)



| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| doc | Hunters drawn on Meshy's own skeleton and clips (scripts/heroes/warden_native.gd, docs/art/wardens/MESHY_NATIVE.md), keyed by art name. meshy_native: the switch (off = the contract model as before; Albert and Vex are listed off until their <art>_meshy.glb is packed and picked). Size: Meshy's head bone onto the rig's head pivot (WardenNative._fit), times size (default 1) where Meshy's body stands off the owner's height chart by over 10% (tools/native_hitbox_check.gd). file: art/wardens/<art>/<art>_meshy.glb. clips: game state -> Meshy clip, plus optional slots (lmb, lmb_hold, rmb, e, r, dash, glide, land, hit, downed, stomp; MESHY_NATIVE.md, Clip slots): a missing one plays today's clip. walk_mps/run_mps/crouch_mps: m/s ground speed each loop plays at rate 1, measured per Hunter by --foot-slide-check (docs/art/FOOT_SLIDE.md); run_from: m/s where the walk hands to the run; attack_rate, jump_rate: play rate of those one-shots. hand: Meshy's bone the weapon's aim node rides. springs: loose parts on Meshy's own bones, each {bones: [names root -> tip], hang: true when its rest is straight down, floor: m its joints stay over the ground}: WardenSprings.setup_named swings them over the clip (Sable's coat tails; absent = the clip's keys only). anchors: anchor empty -> the Meshy bone it rides. crouch_arms_from: the crouch plays that state's clip on the arms (the bones below arm_roots, default LeftShoulder and RightShoulder): Meshy's crouch holds a torch out. toon (default true): the game's hero-toon pass on the surfaces. bones: contract bone -> this Hunter's Meshy bone, for WardenSkeleton.find (Cinder's heel jets on her feet; the 14 contract bones need none: WardenSkeleton.NATIVE). orbits: orbit node of the contract .glb -> the Meshy bone it rides (the props are copied from <art>.glb and turn as on the contract path: Tenzo's seeing-stones). props: contract bone -> material names of the contract model's parts Meshy's mesh lacks, hung on Meshy's bones (WardenProps: Kael's sword, Cinder's heel jets); tilt: contract bone -> degrees its part bends back toward the limb (Kael's blade: his contract rest holds it 47 deg ahead of the arm, his own idle clip bends the wrist; Meshy's clips do not). stretch {kmove, y, rest}: those parts' length along their bone while that kit move plays and otherwise (as the contract clips key Cinder's jet bones: x3 in Flue Flight, x0.06 at rest). kmoves: kit move -> {clip, hold_from, rate, fade, body} (WardenNativeMoves: the move plays that clip at its own clock; body: true also lays its keyed lift and spin on the model root, Gil). plants: state (walk, run, crouch) -> {L, R: the seconds into Meshy's clip that foot touches down}, read off Meshy's foot bones by --step-sync-check, which the footsteps sound on (WardenNativeSteps; no entry: the hidden rig's stride sounds them). |

## warden_stance (`content/rules/warden_stance.json`)



| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| doc | Each Warden's signature stance on the shared rig (scripts/match/warden_stance.gd), keyed by archetype id. gait: how the body stands and moves over its class (HunterAnim.STANCE keys: knee, width, lean, bounce, arm, elbow, cadence, stride, fidgets). pose: offsets on the rig's bones, full in idle and blended into run, aim and abilities at the blend weights below. spine: forward lean (rad, + forward). tilt: the shoulders drop toward the weight leg (rad). twist: the shoulders turn (rad, + left). hip: the hips shift over the weight leg (m). lift: the body up (m, + up). back: the hips back (m). knee: extra bend in both knees (rad). spread: the legs wider apart (rad). free_leg: the free leg's hip (+ forward) and knee bend (rad). head: pitch (+ chin up), yaw (+ left), roll (+ toward the left shoulder) (rad). arm_l: the free left hand's place from its rest (m, model space: x right, y up, z back). carry: the weapon's idle place under Aim, pos (m) and rot (pitch, yaw, roll, rad), free_l 1 to let the left hand off it (free_r 1: the right, for a weapon carried in the left hand); it blends to the aim pose the moment the Hunter fires. leg: the weight leg (l or r). idle: breath (rate, rad/s), breath_amp (x the breathing), shift (s on the weight leg before a short shift to the other), fidget (every and dur in s; body, head, hip and gun offsets at the fidget's peak, wave times over). |
| blend | {"move": 0.45, "aim": 0.55, "ability": 0.4, "rate": 7.0} |

| Setting | Value |

| _doc | The Hunter Wisp's hum (scripts/match/wisp_hum.gd, docs/AUDIO.md): a low loop under every visible downed Hunter. reach_m: metres it is heard from; mate_db / foe_db / own_db: the level for a teammate's, a rival's and your own Wisp (a teammate's is a little louder: it is the one you can save); max_voices: the most hums at once (the nearest win); rise: how far the pitch climbs, as a share, while the revive channel fills. |
| reach_m | 20 |
| mate_db | -8 |
| foe_db | -12 |
| own_db | -14 |
| max_voices | 6 |
| rise | 0.35 |

## wisp_looks (`content/rules/wisp_looks.json`)



| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| _doc | Wisp looks (docs/decisions/0019-downed-wisp.md): what a downed Hunter turns into. Add a look = add an entry under 'looks'; any key left out comes from 'default'. A look is chosen by its id in Save.d['look']['wisp']. Every look keeps the round outline (round = Hunter, critter = Boki). Colours: 'team' (the hunter's side colour, SideColor: you, ally, foe) or a hex string. core.rim_width is the fraction of the radius in the rim colour. body: radius and squash of the round body, head the radius of the head on top. hover is the body centre's height; drag how far the body trails behind the hunter, settle the seconds it takes to catch up (heavy), lean the tilt in radians at full drag. A look may have 'unlock' ('stat:n', Progress.stat) and 'how' (the words for it) to be earned instead of owned from the start. Times in seconds, sizes in metres, sfx names from Sfx.NAMES, hum.db the hum's level. |
| default | default |
| looks | {"default": {"name": "Wisp", "desc": "A round soul-light in your team's colour with a white heart, slow and heavy.", "core": {"rim": "team", "color": "ffffff", "rim_width": 0.3, "glow": 1.3}, "body": {"radius": 0.3, "squash": 0.85, "head": 0.16}, "hover": 0.4, "bob": 0.04, "bob_hz": 0.45, "drag": 0.45, "settle": 0.5, "lean": 0.35, "pop_in": {"time": 0.25, "burst": 14, "sfx": "scan_pop"}, "pop_out": {"time": 0.3, "burst": 18, "sfx": "revive", "hero_from": 0.6, "squash": 0.25}, "snuff": {"time": 0.6, "sfx": "hit"}}} |

## zone_air (`content/rules/zone_air.json`)

Each garden zone's ambient layer (scripts/home/zone_air.gd): one GPUParticles3D over the island, unshaded, no lights, no bursts. Off at the lowest quality preset, count x Settings fx above it. Keys are garden_zones.json ids.

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| off_at | low |
| off_at_doc | The quality preset (Settings.QUALITY) at which no zone has its layer. |
| box | [16.0, 2.0, 12.0] |
| box_doc | m, half-extents of the box round HomeLayout.LANDING the motes start in (the start island is about 32 x 24 m). |
| zones_doc | col: colour (hex) · count: particles at fx 1 · life: s each lives · size: m [width, height] of its quad · y: m above the ground the box centre sits · vel: m/s start velocity · spread: degrees off vel · grav: m/s2 (y) · fade: share of its life it takes to fade in and out (a twinkle at 0.5) |

## Combos

One fighter sets a foe up with a status, the partner pays it off (`content/combos/`).

| Combo | Shows | Set up by | With | Paid off by | Window | Bonus | Bond |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Combo | COMBO | your Boki | stun, root | you | 2.5s | +35% | +5% of a meter |
| Kindling | FLARE | anyone | burn | your Boki's ability | 3s | +25% | +3% of a meter |
| Pounce | POUNCE | you | stun, slow | your Boki | 2.5s | +60% | +4% of a meter |
